reviews.text: Our border collie, Maya, loves Dogs Ville. She is well treated and loved by all the staff; everyone is attentive and concerned about her well-being. We are very happy and recommend Dogs Ville to everyone!

I received excellent service from the very first moment. Lola needed a day at daycare to socialize with her friend Pepe, and they were super attentive to Lola, sending me videos and updates about her, and I could also follow her day at daycare through the cameras. And at the end of the day, they gave me feedback about Lola. I loved it! 🧡🧡🧡
